description: HIFLD Open National Shelter System Facilities is a data set archived in DataLumos, the ICPSR archive of US government data, from the decommissioned Homeland Infrastructure Foundation-Level Data (HIFLD) Open portal (Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) et al.). This map layer turns on all shelter status types at the same time.The National Shelter System feature layer contains facilities that can house individuals in the event of an issued evacuation for the facilities area. Coverage: the United States (US); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and DataLumos (ICPSR) normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support emergency-service and public-facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-datalumos-repository.
